subject: Support response lanes — temporary P2 daytime fallback during migration
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbusbank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary adjustment to P2 responses during core migration

Hi Sean,

Quick note from the Nimbus ops team — we have a planned core banking migration the weekend of Apr 14–15. The migration has an expected spike in operational noise (non-customer-impacting alerts) and a small risk window where some alerts will be triaged as P2 by our system before downstream enrichment confirms impact.

Ask: would Redwood agree to a temporary daytime fallback for certain P2 tickets (non-customer facing, tagged "migration-noise") to a 6-hour response window instead of the usual 2-hour window, limited to Apr 14 00:00 UTC — Apr 15 23:59 UTC? We will provide precise tagging logic and an ops channel.

We understand SLA changes are sensitive — we can accept a one-time credit cap and sign an addendum. Attached is our migration schedule and a proposed escalation matrix.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Director, Infrastructure Operations
Nimbus Bank
[Attachment: migration-schedule.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbusbank.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary adjustment to P2 responses during core migration

Folks — forwarding Nimbus' ask. Key points:
- Timebound: Apr 14–15 (UTC window above)
- Scope: only incidents tagged migration-noise and classified as non-customer-impacting
- Proposed P2 fallback: 6 hours vs our standard 2 hours for that window
- They will accept credit cap; want addendum + escalation matrix signed

Questions for ops/legal: 1) Is 6 hours acceptable as a temporary carve-out (we should preserve P1 SLAs) and 2) what monitoring / tagging guarantees do we need from Nimbus to avoid abuse?

Elena is on the CC; can we give a conditional approval by EOD?

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sla-change-request-20280404.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbusbank.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary adjustment to P2 responses during core migration

Thanks for the flag. A few quick notes:

- Preserve P1: absolutely — P1 response windows stay unchanged.
- Tagging proof: we need the exact query they will use to tag "migration-noise" (CloudWatch/Jira/Datadog rule) and a one-hourly digest during the migration so we can sample.
- Auditability: require a post-mortem within 48 hours for any incident that was reclassified during the window.
- Credit cap: suggest a flat cap (USD value) rather than time-based credits — simpler for billing.
- Escalation path: if an item initially tagged as migration-noise shows customer impact, it must be immediately reclassified and routed to P1 and our on-call must be paged.

If Nimbus agrees to tag transparency + hourly digest + immediate reclassification on customer impact, I can approve the temporary P2 fallback. Please attach the exact tagging rules and addendum language.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Support Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbusbank.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary adjustment to P2 responses during core migration

Elena / team — we can accommodate the temporary P2 daytime fallback with conditions below. This is a conditional approval from support leadership. Please confirm agreement by 2028-04-09 so we can schedule the addendum.

Conditions (summary):
- Window: 2028-04-14 00:00 UTC — 2028-04-15 23:59 UTC only.
- Scope: incidents must be auto-tagged migration-noise by your enrichment pipeline. No manual retro tagging.
- Response SLA: P2 fallback to 6 hours only for scoped tickets. P1 unchanged.
- Monitoring: hourly digest to support@redwood.ai and a shared Slack channel (redwood-nimbus-migration).
- Audit & runbook: you must provide the tagging rule + migration runbook and a post-mortem within 48 hours for any reclassified incident.
- Credit: single flat credit cap of USD 7,500 for the migration window.
- Escalation: if any ticket shows customer impact, immediate reclassification to P1 and on-call paging required. See attached escalation matrix.

Attached: escalation-matrix-nimbusbank.xlsx, migration-runbook.md, signed addendum template (please review and return signed). I will loop Legal/Finance for the credit and addendum execution once you confirm.

If you confirm, Sean — I'll create the internal ticket and notify on-call leads for those dates.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
